title: Automatic Engram retry ticks never send a receipted head on a paused queue, and burn their attempt budget
outcome: Automatic Engram retry ticks never send a receipted head on a paused queue, and burn their attempt budget
acceptance: Either the automatic Engram bind, abort and admission retry owners that release an exact paused head may begin that receipted head's write-ahead, or such a tick does not charge an attempt and the head's preview stops saying it is waiting for an automatic retry; the chosen behaviour is documented in the host-architecture row for receipts.
A test drives an automatic retry tick of a receipted head on a paused queue and pins the chosen behaviour, including the attempt count.

completion.summary: Fixed by the w-9b3a30fde03e landing (master 13063e3b, pushed 23:21:09Z). An automatic Engram bind, abort or admission retry of a receipted head on a paused queue without Resume, or with its write-ahead in flight, parks: it begins nothing, charges nothing, reschedules nothing, and the preview reads "Paused, waiting for Resume". This is documented in the receipt row of docs/features/host-architecture.md. Eight park tests pin it, the retry lineage and attempt count included (test-7f2da5e2, 8 passed). Evaluation 135c81bc passed both criteria.
